اشترطا (form VIII)
# اِشْتَرَطَا (ištaraṭā) /iʃ.ta.ra.tˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
# اُشْتُرِطَا (ušturiṭā) /uʃ.tu.ri.tˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
# اِشْتَرِطَا (ištariṭā) /iʃ.ta.ri.tˤaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
